title: SIR Row: Seven fake claims made on electoral roll by Congress and opposition examined and debunked
shows: Organiser sets out the BJP's account of the revision, from a video the party posted on 25 October 2026 in answer to seven allegations by the INDIA bloc. By the BJP's account, the 13 crore names were only flagged in the drafts as dead, shifted, absent or duplicate, Form 6 itself is unchanged and the Supreme Court upheld the declaration added to it, registration officers in each state still manage the rolls, and about 2.37 crore young electors have been added since the revision began. The BJP also says the three Election Commissioners decide together, lists five safeguards against fraud and defends the 2023 law on appointing them. Organiser adds that these figures need checking against official records. On 12 October 2026 the Supreme Court said it had neither approved nor disapproved the modified Form 6, as Bar and Bench reported. In its affidavit of 26 October 2026 the Commission told the Supreme Court that Form 6 had not been amended and that the declaration is a separate document, as Bar and Bench reported.
quote: The video further states that the change was approved unanimously by all three Election Commissioners and subsequently upheld by the Supreme Court of India.
note: Read in full through Organiser's WordPress API (wp-json/wp/v2/posts/420637) with curl on 26 October 2026, and the byline from the page's JSON-LD. Published 25 October 2026, 9:20 pm IST (datePublished 15:50:21 UTC), by Akanksha Mishra. It relays the video the BJP posted on X as @BJP4India on 25 October 2026 and gives the party's answer to each of seven allegations, with Organiser's own remarks that the figures and legal claims need checking against official records and court orders. Every claim in the summary is the BJP's or Organiser's. It repeats the BJP's claim that the Supreme Court upheld the declaration added to Form 6. The entry court-49 in disputes_research/courts.json records it differently: on 12 October 2026 the Supreme Court said, as Bar and Bench reported, that it had neither approved nor disapproved the modified Form 6, and it listed a fresh petition on the form with the SIR petitions for 27 October. The 13 crore names are the names left off the drafts, 13,39,03,307 in 31 states (data/india/states.json, total.removed). The video itself was not watched, and the quote is Organiser's sentence.
